description: Inputs and outputs of the Updates a TeamRunWorkflow serves to the team tools running inside member segments, and the TeamBoard projection the workflow keeps. The workflow validates each caller against its role.

TeamRole.description: Role of a member in a team run. Only leaders create and assign tasks and finish the team; reviewers submit verdicts; teammates complete the tasks assigned to them.

MemberName.description: Member name, at most 64 ASCII bytes. main is the single-agent member and team the team-level emitter; team rosters may use neither.

NewTask.description: A task the leader adds to the board.

title.description: Short title; at most 200 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

description.description: Task requirements and acceptance criteria; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

deps.description: Task IDs of tasks that already exist on the board and must be completed first. A DAG is built by creating tasks in dependency order.

narrowed_tools.description: Tools allowed for this task; only narrows member permissions.

reviewers.description: Reviewer member names, a subset of the roster's reviewers; empty means every reviewer.

CreateTasksInput.description: Update CreateTasks, leader only: add tasks to the board.

caller.description: Optional caller hint; control overrides it with the member identity from the run capability token.

request_id.description: Effect key; Temporal Update ID MUST equal request_id for retries to deduplicate.

task_ids.description: IDs of the created tasks, in the order of the request.

AssignTaskInput.description: Update AssignTask, leader only: give a task to a member, optionally narrowing its tools.

caller.description: Optional caller hint; control overrides it with the member identity from the run capability token.

narrowed_tools.description: Tools the member is limited to for this task. It can only narrow the member's tool set.

request_id.description: Effect key; Temporal Update ID MUST equal request_id for retries to deduplicate.

SendMessageInput.description: Update SendMessage, any member: put a message in another member's mailbox.

caller.description: Optional caller hint; control overrides it with the member identity from the run capability token.

text.description: Message text; at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

request_id.description: Effect key; Temporal Update ID MUST equal request_id for retries to deduplicate.

CompleteTaskInput.description: Update CompleteTask, the assignee only: hand in the result; the task moves to in_review.

caller.description: Optional caller hint; control overrides it with the member identity from the run capability token.

result_text.description: Task result; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

request_id.description: Effect key; Temporal Update ID MUST equal request_id for retries to deduplicate.

files.description: Result file paths, at most 20; each path is at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

items.description: Workspace-relative file path; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

Verdict.description: A reviewer's ruling on a task result. One reject sends the task back to its assignee.

caller.description: Optional caller hint; control overrides it with the member identity from the run capability token.

comment.description: Review explanation shown to the assignee on rejection; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

request_id.description: Effect key; Temporal Update ID MUST equal request_id for retries to deduplicate.

FinishTeamInput.description: Update FinishTeam, leader only: declare the work done; the workflow runs the leader's final summary segment.

caller.description: Optional caller hint; control overrides it with the member identity from the run capability token.

summary.description: What the team accomplished; at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

request_id.description: Effect key; Temporal Update ID MUST equal request_id for retries to deduplicate.

MemberStatus.description: What a member is doing: idle (no task), working, waiting_input (parked on a question), waiting_approval (parked on a tool approval), finished (no more segments in this run).

RosterEntry.description: A member of the team run.

description.description: Member capability description used for assignment.

TaskStatus.description: pending: ready to be assigned or started. blocked: waits for dependencies. in_progress: a member works on it. in_review: the result waits for reviewers. completed: approved. cancelled: dropped. failed: the task exhausted its failure or review-round limit.

TaskReview.description: A reject from any reviewer vetoes the result.

round.description: Review round; starts at 0 before the first review.

rework_note.description: Rework instructions after a rejected review; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

task_id.description: Task identifier, unique within the team run.

title.description: Short title; at most 200 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

deps.description: Task IDs this task waits for.

attempts.description: How many times the task was started; a rejected result starts a new attempt.

narrowed_tools.description: Tools allowed for this task; only narrows member permissions.

description.description: Task requirements and acceptance criteria; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

result_text.description: Member result for leader synthesis; at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

files.description: Result file paths, at most 20; each path is at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

items.description: Workspace-relative file path; at most 256 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.

failures.description: Number of failed task turns, excluding review rejections.

TeamBoard.description: Projection of the team state, served by the workflow query and mirrored to the UI.

tasks.description: Tasks on the board, in creation order.

comment.description: Review explanation; at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes, authoritatively validated by control.
